title: Scrape the Poopie Out of Your Soul | Art Technique
description: Choe uses scraping, collage and finger painting as metaphors for removing accumulated emotional dirt, moving through a *Titanic* joke, naming current emotions and treating the artist—not the tool—as the vehicle for change.
